comments.overall: You demonstrate good conceptual understanding, but consistency in perspective, stronger creativity, and better presentation techniques are needed. Focus on layout, color choices, and visual communication to elevate your work further.
comments.Q1: Typography is handled reasonably well, but the logo itself is quite basic. The design requires more creativity and stronger visual identity. Color selection can also be improved to make the logo more impactful.
comments.Q2: A good attempt overall. However, the composition appears to be drawn using multiple perspective systems simultaneously. The kitchen area resembles two-point perspective, the refrigerator section appears to follow one-point perspective, and the child seems to be drawn in three-point perspective. The entire composition should follow a consistent three-point perspective. Animal anatomy requires improvement, and the child's height should be more appropriate to the age mentioned in the question.
comments.Q3: The poster concept is interesting, but the overall execution needs improvement. Text placement, typography alignment, use of negative space, and color selection all require further attention. A stronger visual hierarchy would improve communication of the message.
comments.Q4: A good attempt. Adding color would improve the presentation significantly. Try incorporating more futuristic and innovative ideas while presenting your concept. The overall presentation quality can also be enhanced.

ai_before.build: 64/65, the copy the Design team reviewed

comments.overall: You have good design instincts and your presentation is generally neat. Focus on larger drawings, stronger creativity, improved perspective understanding, and making your concepts more innovative. Continue working on visual communication and presentation quality.
comments.Q1: The logo design is visually appealing with a good choice of colors and textures. The typography shows originality and experimentation, which is a positive aspect. However, try to simplify the logo further, as minimalism often creates stronger and more memorable logo designs. Overall, it is a good attempt.
comments.Q2: This composition should have been drawn in three-point perspective because the viewpoint is from a toy car placed on the floor. The current perspective treatment does not fully capture this requirement. Practice three-point perspective compositions to improve accuracy and realism.
comments.Q3: The poster concept is good, but the final output resembles a presentation slide rather than a poster. Posters should communicate a strong message through impactful visuals, meaningful typography, and effective composition. Work on understanding poster design principles and visual hierarchy.
comments.Q4: The shoe design is visually attractive, but the drawing is too small to properly showcase your skills. In drawing-based examinations, the primary object should occupy a significant portion of the page, ideally around half the sheet. The concept itself is somewhat basic, so try developing more innovative and creative solutions.

ai_before.build: 64/65, the copy the Design team reviewed

comments.overall: You need to focus on understanding the question requirements before attempting the solution. Presentation quality, concept development, and shading techniques require improvement. Try to make your compositions complete, visually engaging, and easy to understand.
comments.Q1: The logo is too detailed for effective logo design. Logos should be simple, memorable, and minimal. Try simplifying the design elements and selecting colors that support the concept more effectively.
comments.Q2: You need to work on understanding the complete requirement of the question. The scenario clearly mentions a child standing on a chair and reaching for a cookie box placed on top of the refrigerator. Most of these important elements are missing from your composition, making the scene appear incomplete. The kitchen environment, supporting characters, and overall storytelling need to be developed further. Additionally, shading and rendering require improvement to create depth and realism.
comments.Q4: The concept appears underdeveloped and lacks proper presentation. If you are trying to showcase an origami-inspired shoe design, the inspiration and construction should be clearly visible. A good concept is effective only when it is presented properly on paper. Focus on improving your presentation skills and making your design process easier to understand.
